text:
Situation: Ceftazidime is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, discontinued manufacture of Ceftazidime Injection (package NDC 0409-5092-16) with an initial FDA posting date of 2025-11-14. Current inventory across three sites ranges from 12 to 30.7 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside 2 g presentation is lowest at 12 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include ceftazidime as of 2026-10-21. A prior FDA posting records Hospira discontinued the NDC 0409-5092-16 product with an initial posting date of 2025-11-14.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but the Hospira discontinuation removes a historical source. Sagent Pharmaceuticals is not on FDA's shortage list today and is the rule-based best purchase option.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders for ceftazidime 1 g and 2 g presentations from Sagent Pharmaceuticals to replenish all three sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and supplier communications weekly for status changes; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Inventory team to track daily usage and days-on-hand at each site and report variances above 20%; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No allocation limits, therapeutic substitutions, or compounding changes at this time.
